messages:
Noah: hey team, new hire here. day 1/2 trying to finish dev bootstrap on WSL2 + VSCode Remote. hitting weird mix of asdf vs system node (v14 vs expected v18), GPG signing works in terminal but VSCode shows unsigned, and op signin session doesn't persist for docker-compose tasks. any short checklist or gotchas?
Ivy: welcome Noah! :wave: biggest gotcha is how VSCode is launched. make sure you open the folder from inside WSL via Remote - WSL (use 'code .' from the distro). otherwise processes inherit Windows PATH.
Sam: asdf shims need to be loaded early. in ~/.profile or ~/.zshrc ensure ASDF_DIR is exported before other PATH changes. example:
```bash
export ASDF_DIR="$HOME/.asdf"
export PATH="$ASDF_DIR/bin:$ASDF_DIR/shims:$PATH"
. "$ASDF_DIR/asdf.sh"
```
Noah: that fixed node version mismatch, thanks. GPG next: terminal commits are signed, but VSCode source control shows unsigned and the commit dialog flash for passphrase.
Ivy: run gnupg inside WSL and import your key there. set `git config --global gpg.program /usr/bin/gpg`. install pinentry-curses and add `pinentry-program /usr/bin/pinentry-curses` to ~/.gnupg/gpg-agent.conf then `gpgconf --reload gpg-agent`. launching VSCode from WSL shell also helps.
Sam: if you prefer GUI prompts under WSLg, install pinentry-gtk-2 and point gpg-agent at it.
Noah: op cli: `eval $(op signin my)` in my interactive shell, but when running docker-compose from VSCode tasks the REDWOOD_API_KEY isn't injected.
Ivy: VSCode tasks often use non-login shells. we use direnv + op read. sample .envrc: `export REDWOOD_API_KEY=$(op read "op://Redwood/Dev/REDWOOD_API_KEY")` then `direnv allow`. put op signin eval into ~/.profile so session persists for non-interactive shells, or use a small refresh helper script.
Sam: don't commit secrets. keep .envrc local or .gitignored. we also have an internal helper in the onboarding docs to refresh op sessions on demand.
Noah: corporate CA: docker pulls fail inside WSL with certificate verify errors.
Ivy: copy corp root cert into WSL CA store: `sudo cp /mnt/c/Users/you/corp.crt /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/company.crt && sudo update-ca-certificates` and add cert to Docker Desktop resources if needed. toggle WSL integration off/on after updating.
OnboardingBot: Hi Noah! Check internal guide: https://intranet/redwood/onboarding/dev-setup-wsl for step-by-step WSL, gpg transfer, direnv + op examples, and Docker CA notes.
Noah: perfect, i'll try these and DM if stuck. thanks y'all :thumbsup:
Ivy: happy to pair on GPG or direnv if you want.
Noah: would love that — thank you :heart:
